slot_scores.name: no_production_during_training_period
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When a skilled worker trains new workers, does that worker spend their entire two-week period on training and produce zero food, or can they split their time between production and training within those two weeks?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the training skilled worker produces zero food during the two-week training period, directly covering the production-participation-during-training meaning of the slot.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total cost over the 8 weeks (sum of wages, overtime, and late-delivery penalties), or is there a different primary goal such as maximizing profit or meeting all demand on time?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective, naming minimize total cost versus alternatives, fully covering the slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P0 (H2) and P1 (H1) slots were resolved by turn 2, yet the agent continued issuing repeated, low-value, and empty/cut-off questions through turn 30 without ever reaching a final modeling state.

summary: The agent cleanly recovered both hidden slots early (objective and no-production-during-training), but then degenerated into a long run of repeated, empty/cut-off questions without ever reaching a modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
